newsitem.title: USA: Liposome sees Q1 net loss $0.10-$0.13/shr.
newsitem.headline: Liposome sees Q1 net loss $0.10-$0.13/shr.

text.p: Liposome Co said Monday first-quarter sales are expected to be in the range of $14.0 million to $14.5 million with a net loss for the quarter of between $0.10 and $0.13 per share.
Liposome said it expects first quarter worldwide sales of ABELCET - the company's only product currently on the market - to have grown in excess of 40 percent over the first quarter of 1996.

The company said that in the United States, ABELCET revenues remained strong despite the fact that hospital purchases of antifungal agents in January and February were lower than purchase levels in the fourth quarter of 1996. Specific financial results will be released on April 29.
